leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply attribute selectors to style HTML elements based on their attributes
Construct CSS rules using exact attribute value matching
Configure partial attribute value matching with substring selectors
Implement attribute presence selectors to style elements with specific attributes
Manipulate styling based on attribute values that begin or end with specific strings
Integrate attribute selectors with other CSS selectors to create compound rules
Update existing CSS files to incorporate attribute-based styling techniques
